unresolved_relationships.reason: Main text names Cuvertino EPIC study reference34 but retrieved main-text portion does not contain this accession explicitly. Parent has series-level SOFT and should verify before promoting to an explicit edge.

Both studies involve age-18 whole-blood DNA from the E-Risk twin cohort, with paired 450K/EPIC measurements. The 233-specimen GSE154566 subset may overlap the 350-specimen Sugden comparison; shared cohort/timepoint is evidence to investigate linkage, not proof of identical individuals or a measured overlap.
unresolved_relationships.required_before_joint_use: Reconcile explicit specimen/person and family IDs; keep related/repeated observations together. Do not add the sample counts or promote this to an explicit Sugden-to-GSE154566 use edge without primary confirmation.

unresolved_relationships.reason: Niceta 2024 Methods external RH cohort includes seven molecularly confirmed cases previously characterized in reference 34 (Hildonen 2023), one VUS and 55 healthy controls. Seven case reuse is explicit at publication level; neither exact GSM/array reuse nor individual control overlap is stated. No additional independent replication cohort count is justified. Italian internal samples and the external VUS are not automatically included in GSE218186; the 2024 raw dataset is available on request, not verified as publicly deposited.
